name: Asbestos surveys
title: Best Asbestos Surveys in Leeds
intro: Buying an older house, planning a kitchen refit or worried about an Artex ceiling? An asbestos survey tells you where asbestos is before anyone drills or knocks down a wall. Below are 3 asbestos surveying firms that cover Leeds, the survey types explained and what each one costs.
seo_title: Asbestos Survey Leeds: 3 Local Surveyors Compared (2026)
seo_desc: Asbestos survey in Leeds: 3 firms that survey and test for asbestos, the difference between management and refurbishment surveys, and typical 2026 prices.
h1: Best asbestos surveys in Leeds: 3 local asbestos surveyors
checks: Ask whether the surveyor is UKAS accredited for asbestos surveys, and whether samples go to a UKAS accredited lab.
Tell the surveyor what work you plan, so you get the right survey type: management, or refurbishment and demolition.
Ask how long the written report takes and whether it includes photos and a plan of where samples were taken.

expert_tip.src: HSE: The duty to manage asbestos, arrange an asbestos survey
expert_tip.body: There are two types of asbestos survey: a management survey for normal use of a building, and a refurbishment or demolition survey before building work. Both usually involve taking samples. HSE says asbestos must be removed, as far as reasonably practicable, before major refurbishment or demolition, which is why the right survey matters. Tell the surveyor exactly what work you are planning.

guide.h2: Do you need an asbestos survey?
p: Asbestos was widely used in UK buildings until it was banned in 1999. Many Leeds homes built or refitted before 2000, from Victorian terraces with later Artex ceilings to 1960s and 1970s semis with asbestos garage roofs, may contain it. Asbestos in good condition is usually low risk if left alone. The danger comes when it is drilled, sanded or broken.

You need an asbestos survey before building work that disturbs the fabric of an older property, such as a kitchen or bathroom refit, removing walls or ceilings, or rewiring. Landlords and employers who manage non domestic premises, including the common parts of flats, have a legal duty to manage asbestos.

ul: Management survey: the standard survey for an occupied building. It finds asbestos that could be damaged in normal use and assesses its condition.
Refurbishment and demolition survey: needed before building work. It is intrusive and covers only the area to be worked on, which may need to be empty.
Sample test: for a single material such as a garage roof or a ceiling, one sample sent to a lab can be enough. See asbestos testing in Leeds.

guide.h2: What does an asbestos survey cost in Leeds?
p: Checkatrade's 2026 guide (updated May 2026) puts a management survey of a 2 to 3 bedroom house at about £150 to £350, averaging £250, and a refurbishment or demolition survey at about £300 to £400. MyBuilder gives £50 per sample for standard sampling. Our asbestos survey cost guide has the full figures.

The surveyor walks through the property, inspects likely materials and takes small samples, sealing each sample point. Samples go to a laboratory for analysis. You then get a written report listing each material, whether it contains asbestos, its condition and what to do next: leave it, seal it, or have it removed.

guide.h2: After the survey: removal or management
p: If asbestos is found, you do not always need to remove it. Sound material can often be left and recorded, or sealed. Where removal is needed, see our list of asbestos removal firms in Leeds and our guide to asbestos removal costs.

faqs.q: How much is an asbestos survey for a house?
faqs.a: Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives about £150 to £350 for a management survey of a 2 to 3 bedroom house, averaging £250. A refurbishment and demolition survey averages about £350.

faqs.q: How long does an asbestos survey take?
faqs.a: A survey of a typical house often takes a few hours. The written report usually follows a few days later, once the lab results are back.

faqs.q: Do I need an asbestos survey before buying a house?
faqs.a: It is not a legal requirement for a homebuyer, but it can be worth it for an older property you plan to renovate, so you know the cost before you commit.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a management and a refurbishment survey?
faqs.a: A management survey covers normal use of the building. A refurbishment and demolition survey is intrusive and is needed before building work, so it looks inside walls, floors and ceilings in the area being worked on.

faqs.q: Can I test for asbestos myself?
faqs.a: DIY kits exist, but taking a sample can release fibres. A professional sample, analysed by a UKAS accredited lab, is safer and gives a result you can rely on.
